verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own JavaScript scenario feature can click and fill form fields before the HTML is returned, so a single API call could log in and reach gated content. However, there is no evidence of a persistent browser session for continuing to interact with a page that was already scraped. session_id only keeps the same IP across requests, and cookies are just passed in. Missing for 10: stateful continued interaction with an already-scraped page across calls, documented login-wall or authentication flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall

citations.quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.
